At 5 months, Theo's right on the edge — Health Canada puts the window at around 6 months, so just a few weeks away. Watch for him sitting with minimal support, showing interest in food, and losing the tongue-thrust reflex — those are the green lights, and worth flagging to his provider at the 6-month visit to confirm.
